coverage: Exact remote candidate SHA and completed successful CI run required
Temporary Git index and compare-and-swap candidate reference preserve the user index
Private and generated file paths rejected
Paused branch preparation refuses an active service
Deploy request specifies the checked SHA
Only explicit service-suspension HTTP 409 authorizes resume
Queued HTTP 202 with no body is recorded without assuming a live deployment
Resume evidence must match the service, commit and CI run and be at most 15 minutes old
Resume immediately inspects new deployments and leaves health checks gated until polling
A fresh wrong-SHA deployment causes suspension before build cancellation
Only one live exact-SHA deployment allows external health checks
Provider error bodies stay bounded and never enter records or console output
HTTP 301, 302, 303, 307 and 308 responses are rejected for GET and POST before a second request can forward Authorization
limits: Mocks verify helper logic, not Render execution behavior.
The resume endpoint has no documented guarantee against briefly serving an older image before observation.
Polling must follow resume or queued deployment before external health checks.
